integrity: The proof is symbolic for arbitrary odd \(k=2r+1\). The bundled finite replay checks formulas and normalizations but is not used as a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the surface family with \(d=m=2\) and odd \(k\ge3\).
The literature comparison cannot exclude an equivalent observation stated only in classical toric-surface or scroll terminology.
title: Odd rough Veronese surfaces are Hirzebruch surfaces \(\mathbb F_2\)
